captions.detailed: This 3D model features a quick-action drill-press vise colored in dark gray, light gray, and red accents. It consists of a flat, rectangular base plate with two parallel square-section guide bars running along its length. A fixed rear jaw is positioned at one end, while a sliding front jaw moves along the guide bars. Clamping is secured via a central fine-adjust screw handle and a quick-release cam lever on the side with a red handle tip.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a quick-action drill-press vise with a flat base plate, a fixed rear jaw, and a front jaw that slides along two parallel square-section guide bars. Incorporate a central screw handle for fine adjustment and a side-mounted quick-release cam lever with a red handle on a revolute joint.
captions.factory: Construct the base plate as a thin box with rounded corners and slots. Model the fixed rear jaw and the two parallel guide bars as rectangular prisms. Create the sliding front jaw as a block that straddles the guide bars. Model the fine-adjust screw handle using cylinders and spheres, and construct the side cam lever with a cylinder joint and a rectangular handle tipped with a red cylinder.
